related.title: 量測系統分析 GRR
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：先評估穩定性，規格與管制界限分開，σ來源及近似常態假設明確。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Assess stability first, keep specifications/control limits distinct, and state σ provenance and normality assumptions.
related.difference: 正確合成標準差，區分量測變異占總變異與占公差寬度兩種指標。
related.differenceEn: Combine standard deviations correctly and distinguish study-variation fraction from tolerance fraction.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Cp=(USL−LSL)/(6σ)，Cpk=min(USL−μ,μ−LSL)/(3σ)；使用前需評估穩定性及分布假設。 教學LSL9.90 mm、USL10.10 mm、μ10.04 mm、σ0.02 mm，假定穩定近似常態。 Cp=0.20/0.12=1.6667；上側裕度0.06、下側0.14，Cpk=0.06/0.06=1.0。
獨立變異分量相加，σGRR=√(σrepeat²+σoperator²)；百分比定義需固定，不能直接加標準差。 合成重複性σ0.004 mm、操作者σ0.003 mm、零件σ0.020 mm，公差寬0.20 mm。 σGRR=0.005 mm；6σGRR/公差=15%；σGRR/√(0.020²+0.005²)=24.254%（研究變異比）。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Cp=(USL−LSL)/(6 σ), Cpk=min(USL−μ,μ−LSL)/(3 σ); assess stability and distribution first. TeachingLSL 9.90 mm, USL10.10 mm,μ10.04 mm,σ0.02 mm, assuming stable near-normal behavior. Cp=1.6667; upper/lower margins 0.06/0.14 mm give Cpk=1.0.

Independent variances add:σ GRR=√(σ repeat²+σ operator²); define percentages consistently instead of adding standard deviations. Synthetic repeatability σ0.004 mm, operator σ0.003 mm, part σ0.020 mm, tolerance width 0.20 mm. σ GRR=0.005 mm;6 σ GRR/tolerance=15%;σ GRR/√(0.020²+0.005²)=24.254% study-variation fraction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工業設備再製造
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：先評估穩定性，規格與管制界限分開，σ來源及近似常態假設明確。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Assess stability first, keep specifications/control limits distinct, and state σ provenance and normality assumptions.
related.difference: 把材料保留率、再製能耗與壽命假設分開，避免用較少材料直接宣稱全生命週期較佳。
related.differenceEn: Separate retention, remanufacturing energy and lifetime assumptions instead of equating less material with a better life cycle.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Cp=(USL−LSL)/(6σ)，Cpk=min(USL−μ,μ−LSL)/(3σ)；使用前需評估穩定性及分布假設。 教學LSL9.90 mm、USL10.10 mm、μ10.04 mm、σ0.02 mm，假定穩定近似常態。 Cp=0.20/0.12=1.6667；上側裕度0.06、下側0.14，Cpk=0.06/0.06=1.0。
相同功能與壽命前提下，節能比=(Enew−Ereman)/Enew；功能不等效時需要重新正規化。 合成100 kg設備保留75 kg、替換25 kg；新製1000 kWh，再製拆解30、檢查40、加工180、組裝50 kWh，替換件8 kWh/kg。 Ereman=30+40+180+50+25×8=500 kWh；節能50%，材料保留75%。未含運輸及耗材。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Cp=(USL−LSL)/(6 σ), Cpk=min(USL−μ,μ−LSL)/(3 σ); assess stability and distribution first. TeachingLSL 9.90 mm, USL10.10 mm,μ10.04 mm,σ0.02 mm, assuming stable near-normal behavior. Cp=1.6667; upper/lower margins 0.06/0.14 mm give Cpk=1.0.

At equivalent function/life, saving fraction=(Enew−Ereman)/Enew; nonequivalent service requires renormalization. Synthetic 100 kg unit retains 75 kg and replaces 25 kg; new 1000 k Wh; reman disassembly 30, inspection 40, rework 180, assembly 50 k Wh; replacement parts 8 k Wh/kg. Ereman=500 k Wh; energy saving 50%, material retention 75%, excluding transport and consumables.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
